name: PiOpt
description: PiOpt 是 PI-Desktop 的控制台插件：外观（界面动效的克制预设与实时预览、减弱动态保护、推理强度滑杆的吸附动效，以及可即时开关的窗口磨砂材质与背景图）、行为（聊天框的模型浮窗始终列出全部模型，可按默认顺序 / 供应商 / 厂商 / 名称排列，选中标记可用圆角框替代对勾，推理强度滑杆的档位可译成中文）、远程（同一局域网里配对后的设备可以看会话、发指令、停止运行，电脑浏览器同样可用）与插件市场（读取官方目录，经镜像下载并按 sha256 校验），并在侧边栏左下角第二个按钮后提供一个控制台入口。
author: local

commands.title: Pimarket: 打开市场与更新面板
Pimarket: 准备全部可用更新

agentTools.name: list_plugin_updates
agentTools.description: List installed PI-Desktop plugins that have a newer non-yanked version in the official catalog, with version, size, sha256 and changelog. Reads only local registry/catalog files and returns, for each entry, whether a verified package is already downloaded.

includeInstalled.description: Also list installed plugins that are already current or absent from the catalog.

agentTools.name: prepare_plugin_update
agentTools.description: Download one plugin package into this plugin's data folder, verify sizeBytes and sha256 against the official catalog, and return the absolute .piplug path for the user to install from the Plugins page. Never installs, never edits registry.json, and never keeps a package that fails verification.

version.description: Exact version to fetch. Defaults to the newest non-yanked catalog version.

agentTools.name: remote_status
agentTools.description: Report whether the PiOpt phone gateway is running: on/off, port, the LAN addresses a phone can open, the pairing code, and how many devices are paired. Read-only.

agentTools.name: remote_control
agentTools.description: Start or stop the PiOpt phone gateway, or rotate its pairing code. Starting exposes a LAN page that can read sessions and send prompts until it is stopped.

settings.title: 镜像仓库
settings.description: GitHub 上的插件包镜像仓库，格式 owner/repo。默认 AIUO-Net/pi-desktop-plugins，与官方 catalog 的内容一致。

settings.title: 镜像分支或标签
settings.description: 镜像仓库的 ref，默认 main。

settings.title: 数据目录（可选）
settings.description: 留空使用 ~/.pi-desktop/plugins/data/local.pimarket。下载的包放在其下的 downloads/。

safetyNotes: PiOpt bundles three features that each stay inside their own boundary. The market feature reads the plugin registry and market catalog with Node fs inside the plugin process, writes only its own data folder, and downloads .piplug files over https from four hard-coded hosts, verifying sizeBytes and sha256 before a package is kept; it never installs and never edits registry.json. The appearance feature registers one runtime theme whose CSS carries motion rules (including the snap the reasoning-effort slider makes between stops) and an optional glass layer made only of background fills, gradients and backdrop filters: no color tokens of its own, no remote resources, no file or network access outside its own data folder, where an uploaded wallpaper is written. Each feature keeps its state in the plugin's own settings. ui.theme is used only for that one PiOpt Appearance runtime theme. agent.prompt.inject only indexes skills/piopt.md for on-demand loading. renderer.extension is used for one module that mounts a single entry button into the host window's sidebar footer, right after the second button, coordinates reversible exit/interruption animations on inert clones while motion optimization is active, and rewrites the chat composer's model popup in that window — expanding it, building a sorted list out of cloned buttons, hiding the selected row's check in favour of a ring, and relabelling the reasoning slider's ticks — with RPC actions going through plugin.call back to the plugin process. The module reads no files, sends no network requests and touches no other plugin's UI. The remote feature runs one HTTP server on the LAN only while the user turns it on in the panel: it serves a small phone page plus an API that lists sessions, reads one transcript, sends a prompt and aborts a turn. Sessions and their metadata come from the desktop channel (session/list, session/get); a transcript is read from that session's own jsonl in the PI-Desktop data folder with Node fs - the tail only (256 KB, cached by file size) - the same way the market feature reads the plugin registry, because the desktop channel does not carry message bodies. Prompts and aborts go through desktop.invoke. It never approves tool permissions or plans, never deletes, configures or renames anything, and requires a device token minted by pairing with a six-digit code shown in the panel; pairing is rate limited per address, and the server stops listening on unload or when the panel switch is turned off.

en.name: PiOpt
en.description: PiOpt is the PI-Desktop control console: appearance (unified symmetric motion language at 0.4–2.0x speed applied live with reduced-motion protection, a snap on the reasoning-effort slider, plus an instantly switchable frosted window material with an optional wallpaper), behavior (the chat composer's model popup always lists every model in host order, by provider, by vendor or by name, with an optional rounded frame instead of the selected row's check and Chinese names for the reasoning-effort ticks), the phone (a paired phone on the same LAN can read sessions, send prompts and stop a turn), and a plugin market and update preparer (official catalog, mirrored downloads verified by sha256), plus a console entry in the sidebar footer, right after the second of the host's buttons.
en.safetyNotes: The market feature reads the plugin registry and catalog with Node fs inside the plugin process, writes only its own data folder, and downloads packages over https from four hard-coded hosts, verifying sizeBytes and sha256; it never installs. The appearance feature registers one runtime theme containing motion CSS (including the reasoning-effort slider's snap) and an optional glass layer built only from background fills, gradients and backdrop filters, with no color tokens, network or file access outside its own data folder. ui.theme is used only for that one runtime theme, and agent.prompt.inject only indexes skills/piopt.md for on-demand loading. renderer.extension is used for one module that mounts a single entry button into the host window's sidebar footer and removes it on unload; the same module coordinates reversible animations on inert clones while motion optimization is active and rewrites the chat composer's model popup in that window using cloned buttons, hiding the selected row's check in favour of a ring and relabelling the reasoning slider's ticks when asked, with RPC actions going through plugin.call back to the plugin process. The module reads no files, sends no network requests and touches no other plugin's UI.

zh-CN.name: PiOpt 控制台
zh-CN.description: PiOpt 是 PI-Desktop 的控制台插件：外观（0.4–2.0× 统一对称界面动效、推理强度滑杆的吸附动效与窗口磨砂材质，改完即时生效）、行为（聊天框的模型浮窗始终列出全部模型，可按默认顺序、供应商、厂商或名称排列，选中标记可用圆角框替代对勾，推理强度滑杆的档位可译成中文）、远程（同一局域网里配对后的设备可以看会话、发指令、停止运行，电脑浏览器同样可用）与插件市场（官方目录、镜像下载并按 sha256 校验），并在侧边栏左下角第二个按钮后提供一个控制台入口。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 市场功能在插件进程内用 Node fs 读取插件注册表与官方目录，只写自己的数据目录；.piplug 只从四个硬编码域名走 https 下载，且只有 sizeBytes 与 sha256 校验通过才会保留，从不安装、不改 registry.json。外观功能只注册一个运行时主题，其中只有动效规则（含推理强度滑杆停在每一格时的吸附）与可选的玻璃层（背景填充、渐变、backdrop-filter），不含颜色 token，除自己的数据目录（存放用户选的背景图）外不访问文件或网络。每个功能的状态都存放在插件自己的 settings 中。ui.theme 仅用于这一个外观主题，agent.prompt.inject 仅用于收录 skills/piopt.md。renderer.extension 只用于一个渲染模块：它在宿主窗口侧边栏左下角的按钮栏里挂一个入口按钮，卸载时移除；在开启载荷动效时用惰性克隆协调可往返动画的对称退回与打断；并改写聊天框的模型浮窗（展开全部模型、用克隆按钮按所选方式排列，需要时把选中行的对勾换成圆角边框、把推理强度的档位换成中文）——RPC 均经 plugin.call 交回插件进程。模块不读文件、不访问网络、不触碰其他插件的界面。
